title: Project Manager
description:
**Job Description**

 We are looking for a passionate associate to join the innovation team at NielsenIQ as a Project Manager. We are looking for an associate who has an interest in pursuing a career in the market research , is interested in innovation and working in a fun and energetic team. The role as a Project Manager will support our accelerated business growth in the Western Europe Region and will be situated in our (NIQ OFFICE) office.
   

  





 At NielsenIQ, we put our clients at the centre of what we do, we work hard, and everyone contributes to a team environment of learning and fun. As a Project Manager, you will be supporting study and questionnaire set up and working closely with other internal teams to ensure smooth and quality project execution from survey programming through the delivery of data.
   

  





**Responsibilities**



* Responsible for coordinating projects and executing standard research studies
* Accurately transferring client confirmed inputs into internal questionnaire authoring platforms ready for programming
* Complete quality checks on research materials including questionnaire and survey links to ensure they are error\-free when sent to respondents
* Manage \& update documents and materials across platforms
* Liaise with other client success team members, programming and vendors to ensure the progress of the project is well communicated and monitored to minimize disruption of delays
* Manage the sampling and quota requirements on the survey/router platform
* Adhere to strict timelines and proactively anticipate, troubleshoot, overcome and/or escalate



**A little about you**





 Our Project Managers manage the consistent delivery of utmost quality data to our Analysts and are experts in project execution. The successful candidate will possess the following skills:
   

  





  

  




* Excellent English language skills \- including oral and written communication
* Attention to detail
* Openness and flexibility to change
* Be curious and open\-minded: Keen interest to learn and adapt new technology and platforms
* Critical thinking \& problem\-solving skills
* Organizational and time\-management skills \- the ability to multitask
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Interest in marketing (particularly consumer product marketing) and research
* Flexible working hours (within reason) to help coordinate with other regions

**Qualifications**

* Min 3\+ years exp

* Excellent command of written and spoken English. An added advantage for the ability to communicate in second language
* An effective communicator
* Good attention to detail \- high accuracy and thoroughness

**Our Benefits**



* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off

title: MTS Project Manager
description:
**The opportunity**
 The internal capability lead MTS is responsible for building, internalizing, and scaling a new operating model for high voltage switchgear that enables sustainable growth in a rapidly expanding market.
   

  

 In the first phase, the role partners closely with an external consulting company that is driving to redesign the business execution model. As a key member in the transformational team, the role requires local presence in the concerned Operating Units and Feeder Factories during time of the execution. You will build further competence to support the execution that is planned to be done in staggered waves.
   

  

 In the second phase, we will ramp\-down the engagement of the external consultant and the internal capability lead will put the learned know\-how in action and he/she will apply built competence by scaling across all Hitachi Energy switchgear factories with the local teams.
   

  

 In the third phase you will evolve into the global subject matter expert and become governance and process owner for the new operating model.
   

  

 Through\-out the phases you will closely work with the fit for growth program to establish the process and tool framework to drive for organizational sustainability and backbone creation of the new business model
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Act as internal co\-lead to the external consulting team during local execution
* Actively participate in the local implementation waves
* Execute analytics across the workstream and develop scalable methods
* Proactively drive for risk management and manage roadblocks
* Translate consulting concepts into practical, repeatable and sustainable internal solutions
* Once know\-how is matured, lead local implementation waves
* Provide input to global processes and tools and drive for harmonization
* Become key internal authority in the global subject matter expert community
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your background**
* Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering or Business Administration
* 10\+ years of experience in operations or supply chain in complex value chain setups
* Strong exposure to Engineer\-to\-Order or Make\-to\-Order business models
* Willingness to re\-allocate temporarily to different countries across the regions
* Ability to work effectively alongside external consultants
* Experience in transformational projects and change management is preferred
* Experience with standardization, modularization is preferred
* Exposure to global roll\-out across multiple factories or product lines is preferred
* Required good communication skills and a team player

description:
**Job Title: Supply Chain Assurance Manager – Pacific (Australia and New Zealand)**
 ISS connects people and places to make the world work better. Are you ready to connect to a place where you belong? At our corporate facilities or at client sites – together, we make places while transforming businesses into having even more positive impact on societies, the environment, and our people.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Guindy, Chennai, India
   

  

**Language:** 
 English
   

  

**Main purpose of the position:**
 ISS is looking for dynamic individuals in the supply chain, risk and assurance function to drive CUSTOMER VALUE by securing assurance of subcontractors that provide compliance services to ISS.
   

  

 We’re delighted to be recruiting for a new Supply Chain Assurance Manager to join the ISS Procurement Excellence team. This role will be predominantly working with our Australia and New Zeeland team and Group Supply chain assurance team. Working with suppliers and subcontractors who are aligned with ISS and its customers’ values is critically important to us; the Supply Chain Assurance team drive supply chain compliance with ISS standards and policies on our key customer accounts. You will be responsible for supplier relationship management. Reporting to the Assistant General Manager of Supply Chain Assurance, you will play a key role in adding value to our customer accounts in the Australia and New Zealand, minimising risk exposure via the implementation, delivery, and reinforcement of supplier management processes.
   

  

 You will work cross\-functionally to ensure effective supplier management and strong relationships with both ISS functions and countries (Australia and New Zealand).
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Supplier Relationship Management: Ensure focus with material supplier(s), that delivery is consistent, aligned to scope and quality assured.
* Ensure supplier performance is monitored at defined intervals, and corrective actions are implemented to address performance gaps.
* Creation of supplier contracts with flow\-down terms and conditions for our material suppliers in Australia and New Zeeland providing services to Key Accounts \- liaising with the supplier, Country Legal, the ISS customer account management team and Country Procurement category teams where appropriate. Negotiate terms, pricing and set KPIs and manage the contracts through to signing.
* Work in collaboration with the Vetting team and group assurance team to ensure compliance for suppliers in the assurance programme
* Manage ‘material’ suppliers to complete any client specific requirements
* Conduct audit support activity – introduction meeting including presentation, pre\-audit documentation, collaborate with supplier to close gap closure items and submit relevant documentation for closure
* Management of action plans for our key customer accounts, to incorporate defined standards of compliance with the Group Supply Chain \& Procurement supplier assurance programme
* Managing and reporting on performance by all parties per supplier assurance activity
* Routinely re\-communicating the supplier assurance programme parameters and its importance to all stakeholders and securing their continued buy\-in
* Support as required for wider supplier assurance activities, Procurement Excellence projects, and Supply Chain \& Procurement objectives


**Ideal Candidate**
* Previous employment in Supply Chain Management, Supplier Assurance or Procurement (typically 5\+ years), or strong corporate background in other professional services within a large organisation
* Degree level education or professional qualification (e.g., CIPS) is highly desirable
* Demonstrable experience in stakeholder/relationship management skills
* Strong business acumen, with negotiation skills (experience of working with contracts is highly desirable)
* Organised, thorough, and diligent work ethic; a desire to take ownership of tasks and deadlines, executing activities without micromanagement


**Who you’ll work with:**
* Key Account Director / Key Operation Directors – ensure in first instance Compliance Services are managed effectively.
* Critical and Strategic Suppliers (Key contacts)
* Interact with senior ISS stakeholders in establishing a fact base for implementing and driving performance management of suppliers and subcontractors
* Interact with our customers to define, deliver, and update on the assurance progress and enable a risk
* Drive results through working with country procurement, operations organizations and subcontractor.


**Personal skills you excel:**
* On a personal level, you are structured and demonstrates energy, persistence, and determination in the implementation of projects and initiatives.
* You are diplomatic and persuasive and demonstrates good understanding of the general business principles.
* Moreover, you have great interpersonal skills in building relationship and networking with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Technical Services


**Why ISS**
 Since our founding in 1901, ISS has been a people\-first company. We recognize the power of diversity and celebrate the differences that make us unique. When everyone is free to be themselves, everyone benefits. Our people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves, allowing them to seize opportunities and reach their full potential. We take seriously our obligation to improve lives, make a difference in our communities, and protect our planet — because when we get things right, the world works better. And that is what drives us.
   

  

**ISS is a Place to Be You.**
 Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.
   

  

 Become more.
 **Become ISS.**
**How You’ll Apply**
 Apply directly via the link on this page by submitting a cover letter, CV and other relevant documents for the position you are applying for.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.

**Description**
 Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. * Excellent writing skills, to create artifacts easily digestible by business and tech partners.
